posts.title: Improving Wunge Evaluation Errors
posts.description: In the last post I went over improving parsing errors in wunge, my binary data multitool. The other type of error a user can encounter is an evaluation error . This is when an expression is syntactically correct but can't be evaluated because it doesn't make sense.
